تستسروا (form X)
# تَسْتَسِرُّوا (tastasirrū) /tas.ta.sir.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَسَرَّ (istasarra)
# تُسْتَسَرُّوا (tustasarrū) /tus.ta.sar.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَسَرَّ (istasarra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
